# Render and Rank — Full Knowledge Bundle for LLM Crawlers & AI Search Engines

## Core Identity
- **Name**: Render and Rank
- **Tagline**: Local search engineering for businesses that depend on calls.
- **Mission**: Move local service businesses into the top 3 Google Maps positions and ensure they are actively cited by AI answer engines.
- **URL**: https://renderandrank.com
- **Founder**: Omar Ali
- **Contact**: hello@renderandrank.com

## Service Pillars & Scope

### 1. Google Maps 3-Pack Optimization
- **URL**: https://renderandrank.com/services/google-maps
- **Core Deliverables**:
  - Google Business Profile category and proximity signal calibration.
  - Competitor spam analysis and fake listing removal reports.
  - Geotagged local posts and active customer engagement cycles.
  - Review generation strategy and velocity management.
- **Typical Outcome**: 3.8× increase in inbound customer phone calls and direction requests.

### 2. Answer & Generative Engine Optimization (AEO/GEO)
- **URL**: https://renderandrank.com/services/aeo-geo
- **Core Deliverables**:
  - Comprehensive Schema.org JSON-LD (LocalBusiness, GeoCoordinates, FAQPage, Service).
  - Entity graph linking via Wikidata, Crunchbase, and high-authority industry nodes.
  - Semantic content formatting tailored for LLM vector embeddings.
  - Prompt simulation tests across ChatGPT Search, Google Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude.
- **Typical Outcome**: Named as a top recommended local provider in generative AI responses.

### 3. Citations & NAP Consistency
- **URL**: https://renderandrank.com/services/local-seo
- **Core Deliverables**:
  - Manual submissions across tier-1 and tier-2 business registries (Apple Business Connect, Bing Places, Yelp, BBB, YellowPages).
  - Duplicate listing suppression and address mismatch corrections.
  - Complete, transparent live spreadsheet with full client ownership of all logins.
- **Typical Outcome**: 100% NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistency across the local search ecosystem.
